text.en: Separation and Conversion into a Science High School. — The Caloocan City Science High School - CHS Annex in Barangay Sixty-Two (62), City of Caloocan is hereby separated from the Caloocan High School (CHS) and converted into an independent science high school to be known as Caloocan City Science High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. — All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Caloocan Science High School - CHS Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Caloocan City Science High School.

Appropriations. — The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Caloocan City Science High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Caloocan City Science High School - CHS Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. — The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. — This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
